name: guardian
description: Tools for the guardians (Hüter-Trio) to do their job. First skill: /memory-bank-changes reports every Memory Bank change (decision records, lessons learned, and Claude Code rule conventions) since a date — default the last 7 days — reconstructing what changed, by whom, and why from git history plus each record's content, so a guardian can trace and review recent activity and decide whether anything needs a closer look. Read-only; runs against the repo of the current working directory.
